by: claude: tax back-fill 2015 onward, the four taxes the ten-year report reads (Italy)
note: Italy tax years 2015 to 2025 (calendar), from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries copies dated inside each year (review date in each note), with the EY guide (IVAFE "0.20% from 2014 onward") where the PwC copy still labels the stamp duty with an earlier year. Stamp duty (imposta di bollo) on financial investments held in Italy: 0.2% a year of their value at 31 December (PwC Other taxes, last reviewed 30 Dec 2014). The copy dated in 2015 still labels the rate "for FY 2014"; EY Worldwide Personal Tax Guide 2015-16 (content current on 1 July 2015): IVAFE "The tax rate is 0.20% from 2014 onward" for the same rate on assets held abroad. Financial investments held abroad pay IVAFE at the same 0.2% instead, so the rate is the same either way.
